description: Get one action activation: result payload, status, success flag, logs, start/end/duration. Right after an invocation the detail can return 80322 ACTION_ACTIVATION_NOT_FOUND for ~30-40 s even though the id is already in the activation list — retry after a short wait.

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

name: ncloud_functions_get_action_activation_detail
